title: Project Engineer
abstract: Support the planning & execution of Capital projects for a variety of clients. Brisbane. Entry to mid-level Project Engineer 2+ years post-grad.
screening_questions: How many years of project management experience do you have?
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
Have you worked in a role where you were responsible for authoring and reviewing technical documentation?
How many years' experience do you have as a project engineer?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
How would you rate your English language skills?
Have you completed a qualification in engineering?
Do you have technical writing experience?
content_text:
Company
GRG is a professional engineering consultancy with offices in Brisbane, Melbourne, Sydney, Adelaide and Bendigo specialising in the food processing and pharmaceutical industries, as well as servicing other general industrial and commercial sector clients. We provide comprehensive project management, design and drafting services in Mechanical, Structural, Civil, Electrical and Chemical Engineering.
GRG offers excellent opportunities for the successful candidate to establish themselves within a professional consultancy firm and support delivery of a broad variety of projects, for major brand-name clients. The company enjoys a low turnover of staff due to excellent work conditions and a great team environment, making employment opportunities highly sought after.
We have a very strong suite of active and upcoming projects which has created demand for additional project engineers to join our Brisbane team.
Role
This opportunity is for an entry-level to mid-level, degree qualified engineer with 2+ years of relevant experience in project engineering/project management for capital projects in food industry or similar (eg pharma, FMCG, general manufacturing, packaging, materials handling, industrial automation, etc).
Mechanical, Process or mechatronics degree is preferred, but other disciplines will also be considered with relevant transferrable skills.
The role is focused on project management and project engineering of a variety of capital projects and requires strong communication and people skills as well as a high standard of technical writing skills including professional engineering reports and specifications. To be successful will require professionalism, a good attitude and the ability to interact positively with others, including other team members and clients. You will have an aptitude for problem solving and concept development and the ability to translate project requirements into actionable tasks. On the job support will be provided by other experienced team members, however a certain amount of autonomy is necessary.
Typical daily activity involves a mixture of engineering documentation, analysis, and project management and supervision tasks, through the full project life-cycle from initial scope development and budget through to installation, commissioning and project closure. The work environment is mostly office-based, or onsite at client manufacturing factories or similar. Some work from home flexibility is also possible at times.
As a visible representative of the company liaising directly with clients and contractors, you will maintain and uphold the company's reputation as a respected professional engineering service provider with your exceptional personal presentation, communication skills, and attention to detail.
GRG offers stable, full-time permanent employment in a supportive and friendly team environment.
Must living and have active working rights in Australia. Overseas applicants need not apply.
Requirements
- Engineering Qualification - BEng
- An aptitude for general Project Engineering / Project Management work
- High quality communication skills, particularly written and spoken English
- Professionalism, positive attitude, and enthusiasm
- Australian Drivers Licence
